name: Transparency: AI disclosure, model cards and explanations
description: Transparency: AI disclosure, model cards and explanations. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: State AI disclosure laws, ONC HTI-1 DSI transparency, GDPR Art. 22

controls.title: Patient-facing generative output says AI produced it and how to reach a human
controls.requirement: Patient-facing generative output says AI produced it and how to reach a human.

controls.title: Clinician-facing readings show the model
controls.requirement: Clinician-facing readings show the model, version, inputs used and known limits.

controls.title: A model card per profile records intended use
controls.requirement: A model card per profile records intended use, evaluation results and failure modes.

controls.title: Source attributes of predictive decision support interventions in listed health IT are sto
controls.requirement: Source attributes of predictive decision support interventions in listed health IT are stored with the card.

controls.title: Patients can learn AI was used in their care (links to PRV-19)
controls.requirement: Patients can learn AI was used in their care (links to PRV-19).

controls.title: Significant automated decisions state their logic plainly and offer human review
controls.requirement: Significant automated decisions state their logic plainly and offer human review.

controls.title: Staff and patients can report an AI incident through a documented channel
controls.requirement: Staff and patients can report an AI incident through a documented channel.
